reviews.title: Huge interior and massive airflow for easy building
reviews.comment: I wasn't sure what to expect from a non-name brand, but the build quality on this case actually feels solid. The metal isn't flimsy, and the tempered glass panels give it a clean, open look that makes the internal components the star of the show. Moving my Asus ITX motherboard into this was a breeze because the interior is so spacious. I had plenty of room to maneuver my hands without scraping my knuckles against the top or sides. The cable management holes are well-placed, which kept the finished build looking tidy rather than like a bowl of spaghetti. I do wish the motherboard mounting plate was removable to make the initial install even faster, but it wasn't a dealbreaker. The airflow is massive with nine fans running. You can feel the air moving through the case immediately, which is great for keeping temps down during long sessions. The ARGB lighting looks vibrant through the glass, though the documentation is pretty thin. I had to go hunting online to figure out the specifics of the lighting controller, so be prepared to do a little digging if you want to customize the effects. This is a great choice for anyone looking for a roomy, high-airflow case that comes with all the fans you’ll likely ever need.
reviews.author: 4898inc

reviews.title: Great for a pc build.
reviews.comment: Works great, plenty of room and easy to install. Highly recommend for builds using larger GPUs like the 5080 or 90. Fans were all set up great and it looks amazing. Great value and lots of fans. Only down side was that the cable management isn’t the best.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Best case I have so far
reviews.comment: In complete honesty this case is everything you want from a premium case at an affordable price. It's awesome. I can't wait till I am done with the entire build and I will post pictures. Already comes assembled and cable management is super easy. I highly recommend it.
reviews.author: Ariel

reviews.title: Fast and Easy to work with.......
reviews.comment: I take pride in knowing what is good based of experience and this case is simple. I didn't need the one with all the LED Fans because I have a whole set from another PC. I am glad I decided to go with the fans included in the case. They are far superior to the old LED fans I have. The LEDs of the fans frame also light up. Also, super quiet. If you closed your eyes, you wouldn't know the computer was on.  I have seen Corsair brand PC cases that look like this one, but I don't need a name to be on it as it works like a charm.  The system booted up and has been working like a charm. Simple but looks like more than I was expecting! You will find lots of room for the cable management in the back along with one slot for a 3.5" Hard Drive or smaller, where it is out of sight, leaving the front looking very neat and tidy through the class. That's important to me. I loaded a couple of photos & a short video for your reference.  I hope this helps.
reviews.author: 2CLOS2C

reviews.title: The Case is Great. But Not That Great.
reviews.comment: The case is roomy for the most part. Plenty of ventilation built in, even without the provided fans. The fans will cover the bottom pcie lane of your mobo. Assembly was relatively easy and painless. My only two big complaints would be, the birds nest the fan wires create going to the controller in the back, and the actual front of the case is rather cheesy. But neither is a dealbreaker for me, and it looks just fine under my desk.
reviews.author: JoeDirt
